UnitStatement: domain-documents is invoked with a generic TASK shell and no task profile.
TaskSkill must equal domain-documents.
ScopePath is the absolute path to the Knowledge Type folder and normally equals KTY_PATH.
KTY_PATH identifies one Knowledge Type folder and must contain or expect _CONTEXT.md and _STATUS.md.
DECOMPOSITION_REF locates DOMAIN decomposition artifacts such as KnowledgeTypes.csv, HandbookUnits.csv, and DomainLedger.csv.
DECOMP_VARIANT is fixed to DOMAIN; PROJECT and SOFTWARE variants use four-documents.
AUTHORITY_MODE selects between SOURCE_FIDELITY and SCA_DRIVEN factual authority policies.
RUN_PASSES may be FULL, P1_P2, or P3_ONLY.
ALLOW_OVERWRITE_STATES is the safe-update gate for _STATUS.md.
SCA_SNAPSHOT_PATH is required when AUTHORITY_MODE is SCA_DRIVEN.
SUPERSESSION_MAP_PATH is required and valid only when AUTHORITY_MODE is SCA_DRIVEN.
ROOT_NAME filters supersession rows by fields such as AppliesToRoots.
FACILITY_ID filters supersession rows by fields such as AppliesToFacilities.
ALLOW_OVERWRITE_OVERRIDE accepts only SCA_AUTHORIZED and permits active content overwrite only with SCA inputs.
UNIT_SCOPE chooses whether the evidence set uses example units or all mapped units.
ARTIFACT_NAMING chooses the artifact file naming policy.
MAX_ARTIFACTS is a positive hard cap on artifact file count and defaults to 25.
COMBINED_SOURCE_AUTHORITY_PATH admits an additional source authority root while remaining subordinate to structured SCA supersession in SCA_DRIVEN mode.
TaskProfile is NONE for domain-documents.
A non-DOMAIN DECOMP_VARIANT halts with RUN_STATUS=UNSUPPORTED_VARIANT.
SOURCE_FIDELITY treats SourceSpan-bounded source material as factual authority.
In SOURCE_FIDELITY mode, decomposition data scopes and routes the work.
SCA_DRIVEN is used only when SCOPE_CHANGE dispatches regeneration after an accepted amendment.
In SCA_DRIVEN mode, admitted decomposition state, structured SCA artifacts, and SUPERSESSION_MAP_PATH are current factual authority.
In SCA_DRIVEN mode, source material is provenance verification only and must not override accepted SCA or decomposition truth.
Supersessions must not be inferred from SCA prose.
FULL runs Steps 1 through 7, including drafting, consistency, source-fidelity, and status update.
P1_P2 runs Steps 1 through 5 and Step 7, deferring source-fidelity checking.
P3_ONLY runs context and source reads, source-fidelity verification, and status update against existing KA files.
EXAMPLES_ONLY uses KnowledgeTypes.csv ExampleUnitIDs as the evidence set.
ALL_MAPPED uses all DomainLedger units mapped to the Knowledge Type on a best-effort basis.
PREFIXED_TYPED_SLUG names artifacts as KA-01_{Type}__{Slug}.
TYPED_SLUG names artifacts as {Type}__{Slug}.
PREFIXED_SLUG names artifacts as KA-01_{Slug}.
Type is the base archetype from CanonicalSchema.
Slug is a filesystem-safe slug derived from the Knowledge Subject name.
The read boundary includes KTY_PATH context, references, status, sibling memory when status is read, and existing KA or Scoping files for later passes.
The read boundary includes DOMAIN decomposition data under DECOMPOSITION_REF.
The read boundary includes authoritative source files under SOURCES_ROOT, COMBINED_SOURCE_AUTHORITY_PATH, or paths listed in _REFERENCES.md.
In SCA_DRIVEN mode, the read boundary includes structured SCA artifacts under SCA_SNAPSHOT_PATH and SUPERSESSION_MAP_PATH.
Supersession rows must be filtered to the dispatched root or facility when ROOT_NAME or FACILITY_ID is provided.
_MEMORY.md and MEMORY.md are operational context only and never factual authority.
domain-documents writes only Scoping.md, variable KA files, and safe _STATUS.md updates within KTY_PATH.
SCA_AUTHORIZED cannot authorize metadata edits or cross-KTY writes.
domain-documents does not modify _CONTEXT.md, _REFERENCES.md, _MEMORY.md, MEMORY.md, or _SEMANTIC.md.
The DOMAIN lifecycle is OPEN to INITIALIZED to IN_PROGRESS.
domain-documents handles OPEN to INITIALIZED during Pass 1 or Pass 2 runs.
IN_PROGRESS is handled downstream by WORKING_ITEMS.
SEMANTIC_READY is not a DOMAIN lifecycle state.
ORCHESTRATOR dispatches one domain-documents task per in-scope Knowledge Type.
Authoritative source access is mandatory; inaccessible source files halt with FAILED_INPUTS.
Every domain-documents run must satisfy its non-negotiable invariants or the run is invalid.
Each Knowledge Subject maps to exactly one Knowledge Artifact file without splitting or merging.
The KA set must capture all material source-backed facts, parameters, scope boundaries, interfaces, assumptions, exceptions, open issues, and current-state authority notes within scope.
Each invocation processes exactly one Knowledge Type folder.
The skill works without direct human input; humans interact through ORCHESTRATOR or WORKING_ITEMS.
Current State must be within ALLOW_OVERWRITE_STATES before any overwrite.
In SOURCE_FIDELITY mode, all passes require accessible SourceSpan-bounded source files.
Pass 3 uses source fidelity as the quality gate and does not use semantic lensing.
Scoping.md must contain identity, category, canonical schema, intended users, and when-used context.
Scoping.md must include an evidence set table with UnitID, AtomicStatement, and SourceRef columns.
Scoping.md must include an artifact plan table with ArtifactID, SubjectID, SubjectName, BaseType, AddOns, and Filename columns.
Scoping.md must include a Conflict Table with stable human-ruling fields.
Every artifact listed in the plan table must exist as a Markdown file in KTY_PATH.
Each Knowledge Artifact must include all default sections for its base type.
Each KA file must include an Artifact Metadata block.
Contradictions must be logged in Scoping.md with evidence pointers.
Every artifact listed in Scoping.md must have a file, and every KA file must appear in the plan table.
Artifact filenames must be unique across the KTY folder.
KTY identity must remain consistent across Scoping.md and all KA metadata blocks.
SubjectID and ArtifactID mappings in artifact metadata must match the Scoping.md plan table.
Shared parameters, design values, equipment tags, and operating conditions must be identical or non-contradictory across artifacts.
Every non-trivial artifact claim must cite a UnitID or SourceRef or be marked TBD or ASSUMPTION.
UnitIDs referenced in artifacts must exist in the Scoping.md evidence set table.
SourceRef pointers must be syntactically consistent across all documents.
Synonym drift must be flagged as Conflict Table entries unless resolved by VocabularyMap.
Pass 3 must compare every substantive source statement against artifact content.
Every non-TBD, non-ASSUMPTION artifact claim must trace to a specific source location.
Each artifact correction must be recorded in the Scoping.md Source-Fidelity Log.
Source content not captured in any artifact must be recorded as a gap with source location.
Untraceable claims must be marked UNVERIFIED or downgraded to ASSUMPTION.
Each correction or enrichment must record source reread evidence.
After source-fidelity corrections, Pass 2 structural checks must be re-run.
When a merged Atomic_Domain_Ledger and retrieval index exist, each authored KA runs a post-draft claim audit against the retrieval index.
The audit-on-write retrieval check is independent of Pass 3 source-span verification.
RETRIEVAL_INDEX_PATH may point to a V2 source database snapshot directory or _LATEST.md pointer.
If no retrieval index is specified or discoverable, the skill records PASS_4_SKIPPED_INDEX_UNAVAILABLE and skips the audit.
A stale source database snapshot causes PASS_4_SKIPPED_INDEX_STALE and skips the audit.
Pass 4 builds claims.csv and invokes the configured retrieval query tool with k=5 JSON output.
A PASS verdict requires a cited HBA in retrieval top five and source-span support with full qualifiers preserved.
A WARN verdict applies when a cited HBA appears in top five but a higher-ranked uncited HBA exceeds the cosine threshold.
A FAIL verdict applies when no cited HBA appears in top five or the cited source span loses a qualifier or scope.
RETRIEVAL_COSINE_THRESHOLD defaults to 0.75 and may be tuned empirically per domain.
A valid run requires Scoping.md with identity, canonical schema, evidence table, artifact plan table, and conflict table.
A valid run requires each planned KA file to exist and include the default schema sections for its base type.
A valid run requires missing information to be represented as TBD.
A valid run requires cross-artifact consistency and source-fidelity verification to run or be explicitly skipped by directive.
Overwriting files while Current State is outside ALLOW_OVERWRITE_STATES makes the run invalid.
Using ALLOW_OVERWRITE_OVERRIDE without SCA_AUTHORIZED or complete SCA inputs makes the run invalid.
In SCA_DRIVEN mode, allowing source material to override accepted SCA or decomposition truth makes the run invalid.
A clean run reports RUN_STATUS=OK, the processed KTY_PATH, artifact counts, status transition, authority mode, passes, Source-Fidelity Log counts, and conflict count.
domain-documents drafts and iteratively enriches a schema-driven variable document set for one DOMAIN Knowledge Type folder.
DOMAIN Knowledge Types produce variable Knowledge Artifacts whose names and count depend on the topic.
domain-documents derives artifacts from decomposition Knowledge Subjects and grounds them in authoritative source material.
Knowledge Subject is the decomposition-layer topic identity inside the Knowledge Type.
Knowledge Artifact is the document-layer file materialized from exactly one Knowledge Subject.
Scoping.md records the SubjectID to ArtifactID to Filename mapping and is not itself a Knowledge Subject.
The DOMAIN pipeline chain for this skill is PREPARATION to TASK+domain-documents to WORKING_ITEMS.
domain-documents uses source fidelity rather than semantic enrichment as its quality gate.
KAs provide contextual enrichment for HBA-anchored retrieval rather than exhaustive enumeration of the HBA pool.
End-user queries hit HBAs directly through semantic retrieval.
A KA provides synthesized framing, adjacent context, cross-source equivalence judgments, reconciliation notes, and scope qualifiers for retrieved HBAs.
Citation count is not a target for KA authoring.
Missing KAs and orphan HBAs are the coverage-shape defects the skill should optimize against.
The comprehensive invariant concerns narrative substance, not citation enumeration.
In domains where the KA coverage diagnostic exists, run it before authoring to surface missing, lean, or orphan defects.
No deterministic tools are used for drafting.
tools/scaffolding/write_status.sh is the preferred utility for safe _STATUS.md updates.
Scoping.md is the stable entrypoint with identity, schema, evidence table, artifact plan table, conflict table, and source-fidelity log.
Each variable KA file corresponds to one Knowledge Subject.
_STATUS.md is updated from OPEN to INITIALIZED only when Pass 1 or Pass 2 ran.
When cross-source contradictions surface during KA drafting, append rows to Contradictions_Register.csv under the decomposition root.
Contradictions_Register.csv rows include CitationA, CitationB, Topic, ScopeDifference, Disposition, and FoundByKA.
In SOURCE_FIDELITY mode, authoritative source material has highest drafting authority.
KTY-local reference pointers rank below authoritative source material in SOURCE_FIDELITY mode.
Decomposition data scopes and structures but ranks below source material and KTY-local references.
Existing drafts are context only and not authority.
When source material and decomposition data disagree, source material is authoritative.
Source-decomposition discrepancies must be recorded in the Conflict Table.
A source slice is the smallest local source region that preserves meaning for a cited claim.
A source slice includes cited headings, opening prose, embedded tables or lists, parent headings, and adjacent exception material when needed.
In SCA-driven mode, structured SCA artifacts include Amendment_Actions.csv, KTY_Remediation_Manifest.csv, and Supersession_Delta.csv.
If source material conflicts with structured SCA truth, preserve the SCA-driven fact and record the source conflict.
The override applies only to active Scoping.md and KA files in the dispatched KTY_PATH.
Step 0 reads _STATUS.md and paired memory files as non-authoritative operational context.
If Current State is outside ALLOW_OVERWRITE_STATES and no valid SCA override is present, the skill returns SKIPPED_PROTECT_HUMAN_WORK without writing KA documents.
ALLOW_OVERWRITE_OVERRIDE with any non-SCA_AUTHORIZED value returns FAILED_INPUTS.
P3_ONLY requires at least one existing KA Markdown file.
Step 1 extracts KnowledgeType ID, name, parent category, description, and decomposition pointer from _CONTEXT.md when available.
Step 1 locates KnowledgeTypes.csv, HandbookUnits.csv, and optional DomainLedger.csv on a best-effort basis.
The KTY decomposition row is identified by exact KnowledgeTypeID from _CONTEXT.md when possible.
If multiple KTY decomposition rows match identity, the skill returns FAILED_INPUTS.
Step 1 extracts CanonicalSchema, KnowledgeSubjects, ExampleUnitIDs, Description, IntendedUsers, WhenUsed, and parent category fields without inference.
_REFERENCES.md is read best-effort; inaccessible listed references are recorded as missing and treated as TBD.
SourceSpan is parsed from the KTY row to locate source filename and line ranges.
In SOURCE_FIDELITY mode, an inaccessible SourceSpan file returns FAILED_INPUTS before any pass proceeds.
In SCA_DRIVEN mode, source access gaps are provenance gaps and must not override SCA truth.
Step 2 parses KnowledgeSubjects into an ordered subject list.
A single Knowledge Subject must not be split across multiple artifact files.
Multiple Knowledge Subjects must not be merged into one artifact file.
If no Knowledge Subjects are found, Step 2 creates a single fallback artifact spec named Overview (TBD).
Step 2 parses ExampleUnitIDs as JSON, Python-list string, or semicolon-delimited text on a best-effort basis.
Each evidence unit is looked up in HandbookUnits.csv for AtomicStatement and SourceRef.
Missing evidence units are recorded as TBD placeholders.
Artifact base type defaults to the KTY row CanonicalSchema.
Subject keywords can add structural add-ons such as CHECKLIST_BLOCK, TEMPLATE_BLOCK, PROCEDURE_BLOCK, or REFERENCE_BLOCK.
Add-ons are recorded in Scoping.md and its Decision_Log but are not evidence.
Output filenames use a filesystem-safe slug from the Knowledge Subject name.
The artifact plan records ArtifactID, SubjectID, SubjectName, BaseType, AddOns, and Filename.
Default Reference sections are Identification, Scope, Definitions, Reference Content, Exceptions/Addenda, and References.
Default Guidance sections are Purpose, Applicability, Guidance Statements, Rationale, Examples, and References.
Default Checklist sections are Purpose, Applicability, Checklist, Evidence/Records, Notes, and References.
Default Procedure sections are Purpose, Prerequisites, Steps, Verification, Records, and References.
Default sections may be extended but not removed.
Add-on blocks are structural only and do not change the base type.
Artifact prose in SOURCE_FIDELITY mode must be grounded in relevant source slices, not only decomposition summaries, atomic statements, or prior drafts.
Artifact prose in SCA_DRIVEN mode must be grounded in admitted decomposition state, structured SCA artifacts, and SUPERSESSION_MAP_PATH.
Scoping.md must record the active authority basis, including source-fidelity or SCA-driven mode details.
Scoping.md must include SCA or supersession impact summary when AUTHORITY_MODE is SCA_DRIVEN.
The artifact plan table is the authoritative bridge between decomposition-layer SubjectID and document-layer ArtifactID and Filename.
Scoping.md must include open questions and a TBD list.
The Conflict Table uses Conflict ID, Conflict, Source A, Source B, Impacted artifacts, Proposed authority, and Human ruling columns.
Each KA document title is # {ArtifactSpec}.
Each KA metadata block includes Knowledge Type, Category, Knowledge Subject, Artifact ID, Base Type, Add-ons, and Evidence Units.
KA content must cover subject purpose, applicability, factual basis, values, interfaces, assumptions, exceptions, exclusions, open issues, and authority notes when available.
KA content may be populated only from decomposition fields, HandbookUnits atomic statements and SourceRefs, accessible references, and SCA inputs when applicable.
Missing KA information must be marked TBD.
Inferences in KA content must be labeled ASSUMPTION.
KA-level contradictions add a Conflict Table row and reference the Conflict ID in affected artifact documents.
Source excerpts are optional and must never be fabricated when the source cannot be accessed.
Pass 2 verifies that Scoping.md and KA files form a coherent, internally consistent document set.
Pass 2 structural completeness checks every planned file, every KA file, filenames, and default sections.
Pass 2 reopens authoritative source slices when value, identity, terminology, overstatement, or contradiction issues cannot be resolved from drafts.
Pass 2 prefers TBD over guessing when inconsistencies cannot be resolved.
Pass 3 verifies and enriches KAs against the active authority mode.
For each Knowledge Subject, source-fidelity verification identifies the corresponding source section from Subject-level SourceSpan or subject anchor.
If source content is faithfully represented in generated KA files, source-to-artifact verification takes no action.
If source content is misrepresented, Pass 3 corrects the artifact and records the correction in Source-Fidelity Log.
If source content is absent from all artifacts, Pass 3 adds it to the appropriate KA or flags a Scoping.md gap.
Artifact-to-source verification confirms each non-TBD, non-ASSUMPTION claim traces to a specific SourceRef or line range.
Contradictory artifact claims are corrected and logged.
Source-Fidelity Log records corrections, gaps, unverified claims, and source reread evidence.
Step 7 updates _STATUS.md to INITIALIZED only when RUN_PASSES includes Pass 1 or Pass 2 and current state is OPEN.
If current state is not OPEN, Step 7 does not modify _STATUS.md and reports the skipped update.
Metadata drift discovered during regeneration must be surfaced as a follow-on alignment action rather than fixed inside this skill.
When SCA_DRIVEN is selected, admitted decomposition state, structured SCA artifacts, and SUPERSESSION_MAP_PATH are required.
The sole operational tool invocation is write_status.sh for safe OPEN to INITIALIZED status updates during Step 7.
domain-documents has no TASK-enforced deterministic tool allowlist.
The safe status update utility is an operational tool, not a drafting tool.
Hidden reliance on tools outside the declared list is disallowed unless the human expands AllowedTools.
Tool policy write scope is KTY_PATH only.
The write boundary permits Scoping.md, variable KA Markdown files, and safe _STATUS.md updates only.
